fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-01-21, around 02:40, the complainant reported that a white auto bearing registration number TN-33-XX-1066 was missing from the stand near Tamarai Garden Parking Area in Coimbatore, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-01-21. The complaint was lodged by Meena Ammal (9000000431). Abirami Sekar (9000000186) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant alleged that Arun Babu may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000379. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Auto reportedly taken from an unattended stand during the night.
